newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 1,600 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Tuesday.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 1,000 head were sold. "All cattle crossed were previously contracted." Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said. No prices were cited.
Through Eagle Pass, Texas, around 200 head were sold, and through, Del Rio, Texas around 400 head were sold. But in both crossings there was not enough trade to establish trend prices.
